files.README.md:
# Tideswell Terminal - berth office

Shift reports count the boxes lifted on each berth by length.
The quay report the harbour board gets counts everything in twenty-foot equivalents.

turns.prompt: Tideswell Terminal is closing out the September shift on berth 3. The shift lifted 385 forty-foot boxes and 46 twenty-foot boxes. The quay report counts boxes in twenty-foot equivalents. How many twenty-foot equivalents did berth 3 lift?
